study type: Observational study with a cross-sectional assessment of risk factors and a short-term follow-up for treatment efficacy.
cohort: Infants presenting with positional cranial deformations (positional plagiocephaly and positional brachycephaly).
finding: While no significant correlation was found between the severity of cranial deformation and risk factors, some risk factors were correlated with the kind of positional cranial deformation, and helmet therapy significantly reduced positional plagiocephaly.
cross-section timing: At the time of assessment for positional cranial deformations.
